renderingRules.base: background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, c0 0%, c1 100%)  — the CSS equivalent of the mobile gradient {0,0} → {1,1}
renderingRules.decorReference: size = d.size * (height * 1.5); left = x*100%; top = y*100%; margin-left/-top = -size/2
renderingRules.ring: border: max(2px, height*0.07) solid #fff; background: transparent
renderingRules.stripe: width = size*2.4; height = height*0.16; margin-left = -size*1.2; margin-top = -height*0.08; rotate(-24deg)
renderingRules.arc: decor[0] is a ring at size*2.2; the rest are orbs
renderingRules.radius: Circles emit 50% (identical to mobile borderRadius: size/2) and the stripe emits height/2 px (identical to mobile 999 clamped). No literal 999px is produced.
renderingRules.aria: every decor span is aria-hidden="true"; the artwork carries no information
